prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished-game art-direction reference for polishing ONE giant luminous koi in a cyberpunk racing game. Create a spectacular but coherent high-end cinematic 3D concept image, landscape 16:9.
Scene: rainy midnight city canyon, restrained dense charcoal towers, a wet elevated racing road curving gently left, continuous thin cyan rail lighting on the left and magenta on the right. Low third-person racing camera close behind a small recognizable silver twin-pod antigravity racing craft with two blue exhausts, craft confined to bottom center and less than 12 percent of image width. The road remains readable below.
Hero: ONE enormous red-orange holographic koi approximately 130 metres long swimming freely across the bend very LOW above the driving line. Its luminous belly is about 10 metres above the road; the driver is about to pass intimately beneath it. Full fish silhouette dominates the upper two-thirds, roughly 75 percent of image width, head to left in a three-quarter side view, long tail curving toward upper right. Convey tremendous scale through proximity and the tiny vehicle. Elegant gently curved S-shaped swimming body, anatomically convincing carp head, small wet luminous eye, subtle curved gill cover, delicate paired barbels, continuous tapered body into tail. Graceful long split caudal fins and soft swept dorsal and pectoral fins shaped like flowing translucent silk. Layered curved membranes with a few fine light filaments organically trailing beyond their edges. Smooth flowing tips and natural variation, not a rigid radial comb or straight triangular fan.
Materials and illumination: red and vermilion light with a pearl-white hot dorsal crest, amber highlights and darker translucent crimson inner body. Clearly volumetric yet partly transparent, city details faintly visible through the thin fins and belly. Refined overlapping scale microstructure catches scattered light; scales are delicate softly integrated anatomical detail, never repeated outlined circles. The fish appears made of projected light and glowing translucent particles, with a coherent readable anatomy. Smooth surface gradients, exquisitely controlled bloom that preserves the silhouette, selective tiny drifting sparks shedding from the tail. Warm red spill genuinely lights nearby facades, humid air and the ship; a soft broken wet-road reflection establishes the fish directly overhead. Cool atmospheric blue city shadows balance the warm luminous animal. Rich material depth, high-quality antialiasing, sophisticated contrast, beautiful cinematic composition.
Constraints: one fish only. Keep the subject readable and polished. No solid plastic, opaque orange toy, ceramic statue, rigid wire fan, angular sawtooth fins, cylindrical body seams, stiff straight fish, neon outline-only fish, oversaturated featureless red blob, ornamental ring, mounting stand or hoop. No circular plaza or extra landmark. No text, logos, watermark, HUD, labels or inset panels. This is an aspirational visual reference, not a screenshot claim. Prioritize the fish anatomy, luminous material and close overhead relationship over inventing new city architecture.
